rules: Every one of the 568 original observations maps exactly once; original triage and page locators are immutable.
Probable same-practice groups are reversible review suggestions, not automatic deduplication or source proof.
Related families show conceptual proximity ONLY: rites, domestic custom, ministerial blessing, and regional variant remain distinct.
Historical-only material never becomes how-to guidance without separate approval; excluded folklore remains permanently held.
Canonical owner IDs represent candidate/enrichment links, not released changes; PR #1516 is still draft.
Independent witness register coverage is limited to its explicitly enumerated entries; no inference from neighbouring records.
One canonical custom may have several regional attestations; Calendar is the exclusive date owner, Saints owns biography, Pray owns prayers, Mass owns rites.
Do not copy Weiser's book text; preserve locator, make original independent editorial paraphrases only after source and scope checks.
Closely related but nonidentical historical celebrations are listed only as related families, never as same-practice dedup candidates.

related_variant_families.title: Local patronal celebrations

related_variant_families.title: Marian Assumption processions and field blessings

related_variant_families.title: Christmas crib and manger customs
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Construction, prayer, decoration, and church ceremony are different acts, not multiple canonical customs by default.

related_variant_families.title: Epiphany sacramental water and home usage

related_variant_families.title: Christmas child gift practices

related_variant_families.title: All Souls cemetery remembrance
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Keep home candle, parish bell, Polish names and grave visit attached to distinct actions/geo.

related_variant_families.title: All Souls charity and soul-bread variants
related_variant_families.editorial_note: One charity-related historical family, not one fixed recipe, prescribed alms or 1962 octave.

related_variant_families.title: St Joseph charity and festive foods
related_variant_families.editorial_note: The charity table is corroborated; specific fritelli and meal customs have separate evidence gates.

related_variant_families.title: St Anthony almsgiving and devotions
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Do not conflate charity, patron invocation for lost objects and Lisbon pilgrimage.

related_variant_families.title: St Christopher blessings and devotional objects
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Feast, priestly blessing, medal, image and excluded protection guarantee have separate gates.

related_variant_families.title: St Blaise ministerial blessing and foods
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Do not infer that the food custom or wick variant is standard Roman Ritual.

related_variant_families.title: Easter food and egg blessings
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Retain ministerial food-blessing variants and eggs as symbols/food/children's gifts separately.

related_variant_families.title: Palm branches: liturgy and household use
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Blessing/procession is not equivalent to a private household or farming custom.

related_variant_families.title: Corpus Christi procession and route adornment
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Procession, outdoor decor, ritual blessing, and post-feast home use belong to different owners.

related_variant_families.title: Embertide and Rogations seasonal prayers
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Do not treat Ember days and Rogations as the same feast or rite.

related_variant_families.title: Holy Thursday repository and visits
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Only actual rite selection triggers the reader; household/lay visits stay optional.

related_variant_families.title: St Patrick national and family customs

related_variant_families.title: Pentecost doves and decorative greenery
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Historical suppressed pageants do not authorize current liturgical modifications.

related_variant_families.title: Epiphany cake, charity and gifts
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Cake, poor-share, Magi gifts and Befana traditions have distinct geographic facts.

related_variant_families.title: Corpus Christi floral wreaths
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Regional decorations, priestly wreath blessing and home display are not interchangeable.

related_variant_families.title: St John Baptist fire customs
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Breton seafaring rite remains unverified; exclude magical claims and fire-risk instructions.

related_variant_families.title: Trinity symbolic religious art
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Architecture, symbols, personal prayer and civic statues are different subjects.

related_variant_families.title: Historic saints pilgrimage examples
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Retain site links to canonical Places when independently verified.

related_variant_families.title: Advent adopted and household preparations
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Protestant-origin or adopted seasonal custom is not native to all Roman Catholic regions.

related_variant_families.title: Holy Saturday Easter Vigil versus household food customs
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Do not attach private food or folklore events to the 48-card Mass reader.

related_variant_families.title: French and other grape/harvest Marian customs
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Different Marian feasts/localities; independent grape blessings still need a witness.

related_variant_families.title: Christmas Nativity pilgrimage drama
related_variant_families.editorial_note: Polish Kolednicy and szopka house drama may overlap; do not collapse before locality check.

related_variant_families.title: Good Friday voluntary silence
related_variant_families.editorial_note: General Lent and Good Friday observance are not the same custom; explicit manual review.
